product_guards: Require independently requested same-host direct HTTPS HTML typed 200 observations for three distinct URLs: self-canonical source, noncanonical alias and self-canonical destination. Require literal URL/final URL/canonical identities, no errors/blocked hosts/redirects/noindex/none, explicit canonical/lang/served_lang/hreflang map/raw fields and coherent duplicate observations. Do not infer a destination observation from another request's final URL.

The source must declare exactly two unique non-x-default language annotations: its own actual language pointing to itself and one other language pointing to the alias. The alias and destination must declare that other language and the same projected two-language table, including a return to the source. Source and destination served_lang must match their declared language; the alias may have served_lang explicitly null as in the auditor. Code syntax follows the auditor, not a complete registry or content-language detector. A canonical target alone is not evidence of a translation.

Verify only pairs evidenced for impacted source pages. Conflicting proposals, incomplete groups, unknown/malformed fields, contradictory observations, wrong languages or missing returns refuse with an explicit empty protected plan. Name unproved pages when accepting a subset. Individual and grouped corrections share this path; free-form/cached/confirmed model previews cannot bypass it, and no generic head rewrite or AI fallback is used.

Re-read the unique nonshared literal HTML route, current content/blob SHA and bounded routing configuration. Refuse shared/framework/nonliteral/ambiguous/query-colliding sources, scripts/templates/base/refresh, malformed structure, duplicate attributes or codes, media/type/as-qualified alternates, unquoted hrefs and ambiguous source offsets. A bounded attribute lexer must agree with the standard HTML parser; an href-looking string inside another attribute is not a real href. Require actual source language and every annotation to match the observations.

Before the first PUT, complete every file/routing check and fresh bounded streamed direct public-target HTTPS probes for each planned source, alias and destination. Canonical, actual language, indexability and all annotations must still match. No missing-language opt-in or native preview exemption is enabled by this path. An insufficient whole-set file budget refuses before writing.

Replace only the actual quoted alternate href value, escaping the new URL and preserving every other byte and line ending, including canonical/OG/navigation/comment values containing the old URL. Limit input/output to 80000 UTF-8 bytes. Repeat application changes nothing. No provider request or AI quota charge is used. Each write is SHA-guarded; stop and explicitly report remaining files on failure without claiming atomic multi-file writes.

live_cycle_and_reassessment.explanation: The original harness required the reciprocal family to remain unchanged. Repairing the single source href also resolves the observed canonical destination's return anomaly. Preserve the original failed record and reports; amend the benchmark to require exactly the observed reciprocal count and examples change, with every other count/example and requested observation still protected. Reassess the same existing builds read-only; do not present this as a new successful live run or overwrite its failure.
live_cycle_and_reassessment.preput_http_namespace: Map only the three exact owned production-namespace targets to their actual baseline preview and remove only the verified exact native Netlify noindex header. Actual status/body/canonical/meta robots and streamed HTML remain real. This projection is confined to the test harness: six fresh native preview probes are rejected by the unchanged product guard.
live_cycle_and_reassessment.reciprocal_examples: Before: the preceding self-language fixture source and this new canonical English destination. After: only the preceding self-language fixture source. Count alone is insufficient.

independent_countercheck.checks: Re-read exact branch heads, closed draft unmerged PRs, successful builds, four setup commits/files and one corrective commit/file. A separate HTMLParser identifies the actual English alternate, independently derives its sole href splice, checks language/canonical/all annotations/meta, and compares full fresh served bodies allowing only the exact owned Netlify deploy-id to vary. Re-read both served XML documents, routing/index/alias/destination sources; alias and destination controls remain byte-identical. Re-prepare the valid subset and both refusals and verify idempotence without models/targeting/writes/quota. Match all eight current normalized source/test hashes to both final manifests and retain twelve original snapshot hashes.

acceptance_inventory.legacy_hidden_diagnostic_not_promoted: The intentionally non-offered legacy absent-canonical diagnostic remains unchanged; no task is enabled merely to reduce the named-reference gap.

initial_red.explanation: The first run exposes missing protected preparation/module/probes, but also a missing concatenation operator in the new HTML helper. It is not evidence of 133 independent product defects. Fix the helper before accepting the green tests.

development_checks: The initial green run has eight helper failures; the corrected helper passes 769 tests. One later benchmark negative mutation was a no-op because the synthetic viewport was already null; give the positive witness its actual known healthy viewport before asserting rejection. Following preflight passes 698 tests without weakening route or observation guards.

The first full suite has two failures and the following full suite has one: the old rewrite-binding matrix expected a generic callback for an unproved group, and the CI workflow test assumed its new task was inside the first shared-queue batch of 100. Update the existing matrix to assert both explicit refusal of the old unsafe fixture and guarded acceptance of an independently proved group. No test is skipped.

The CI test passes all 35 cases in isolation but not after the enlarged shared suite. A read-only scratch SQLite inspection shows 117 pending verification notes, exceeding the default batch. The test now counts its shared database tasks and explicitly requests a batch covering them, retaining its original status/merge assertions. Scheduler product code, ordering and default batch capacity are unchanged. The mixed workflow passes 431 tests with two existing skips; this is test isolation, not a capacity or production scheduler certification.

The original live harness failure is retained separately. The amended benchmark requires the exact reciprocal count and examples effect, rejects collateral changes and increases, and is tested before read-only reassessment of the same builds. Product/module and core/endpoint tests remain unchanged from the live writes.

Eight implementation/test files are frozen before both final suites. Both manifests are identical, all results are green and the fresh read-only countercheck on 07/10/2026 matches the same eight hashes. No source or test changes occur during these final runs.

limitations: Only one independently proved literal same-host static HTML bilingual alias group is repaired here. Both original ambiguous controls remain unchanged, so the primary family is not fully resolved even on this fixture. Larger/x-default/conflicting groups, unproved language/return/destination identities and nonliteral/shared/framework sources refuse; no all-stacks or all-occurrences guarantee is claimed.

Declarations are not semantic translation-content proof, a language detector or a complete language/subtag registry. The target is an observed declared self canonical, not a Google-selected canonical. No translation is invented and no unrelated canonical, navigation or social tag is rewritten.

Native previews retain noindex and production canonical-host context with zero raw sitemap seeds. The raw primary and reciprocal families remain zero to zero because these checks filter nonindexable previews. Only the bounded owned indexable-host/header projection measures three to two and two to one; it does not prove production indexability. Fresh actual HTML/XML and six genuinely rejected native probes corroborate the bounded literal repair, not a production deployment.

Source reads, SHA-guarded writes, network probes and future deployments are not atomic. A multi-file failure can leave an explicitly reported partial branch. Existing public-target validation is reused, not certified as a complete SSRF/DNS-rebinding audit. JavaScript DOM execution, framework routing and production indexation are not verified.

No agent deployment, customer onboarding, fresh real Claude integration, production recovery replay, scheduler/payment acceptance, capacity test or fresh PostgreSQL run is included. SQLite retains 42 skipped tests. Five claimed families still lack exact named records, including a deliberately hidden legacy diagnostic; named references are not successful repairs or client-readiness certification.
